stepExplanation: For f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c, the x-coordinate of the turning point is x = -b/(2a). Here a = 1, b = -6, so x = -(-6)/(2(1)) = 6/2 = 3.
stepTitle: Find the x-coordinate of the turning point
stepBody: For the parabola f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 5, use the formula x = -b/(2a) to find the x-coordinate of the turning point. What is the value of x?
